facts.fact: Decree 25/041 of 4 December 2025 creates the Registre Social Unique to pool and harmonise the household targeting systems of social programmes and to centralise beneficiaries' biographic, demographic and biometric data; the summary says it is to be interoperable with other information systems, and the full text is paywalled.

systems.owner: Comite de pilotage and Unite technique de gestion

facts.fact: The government adopted on 25 July 2025 the draft decree creating the Registre Social Unique, described as a single database on household profiles on which targeted interventions of social protection projects and programmes are to be based.

systems.owner: Ministere des Affaires Sociales, Actions humanitaires et Solidarite nationale

facts.fact: MINAS says the RSU supplies lists of eligible households to partner social programmes under data-sharing protocols, and partner programmes return information on services received and changes to beneficiaries.
MINAS says the RSU provides eligible-household lists to the different social programmes, including State ones, after data-sharing protocols and a framework partnership agreement are signed.

note: Partnership agreements and data-sharing protocols are still to be signed; no link in build or in service is stated.
